query:
SELECT jsonb_set(e.document->'folder', '{role}',
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(e.document->'detected_role', 'null'::jsonb), e.document->'folder'->'role')) AS "folder!",
                      COALESCE((e.document->>'monitored')::boolean, true) AS "monitored!"
               FROM imap_state_entries e JOIN imap_accounts a ON a.link_id=e.link_id
               WHERE a.link_id=$1 AND a.sync_generation=$2 AND a.grant_generation=$3 AND e.kind='folder'
               ORDER BY e.key LIMIT $4
